config.scope: MQuAKE-derived controlled continuous-memory experiment; not a natural-language benchmark
config.training_information: All unique original atomic facts from structurally eligible MQuAKE cases; no two-hop target supervision
config.evaluation: All unique eligible original two-hop chains; candidate outputs are all entities in the retained graph
config.ambiguity_policy: Exclude every chain containing a subject-relation key with multiple object IDs in the source subset
config.policy: All 12 configurations and both interfaces; no outcome-selected width, seed, or case; oracle clean queries and certificates are offline diagnostics

graph.note: Atomic facts include evaluation-chain constituent facts by design. This is transductive fact composition, not unseen atomic knowledge.

results_scope: MQuAKE-derived controlled continuous-memory experiment; not a natural-language benchmark
